$comment: Functions Resolver Extension Schema (Derived). A function resolver extension is implemented as an MFE entry. Function execution is triggered by that MFE entry receiving a function run action; upon finishing, the entry returns the result to the function resolver extensions domain by sending a function return action.

params.$comment: Function params schema. The params value of an execute or run action is validated against this schema by the function resolver extensions domain.

result.$comment: Function result schema. The function execution result value is validated against this schema by the function resolver extensions domain.
